content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) for filling vacant positions under sponsored projects and research initiatives.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IIT Kharagpur 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Senior Research Fellow (SRF), offering contractual employment opportunities for eligible and experienced candidates in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position under advertisement number IIT/SRIC/R/NGS/2026/112.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Kharagpur SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 23-10-2026. Applicants are advised to complete the submission well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course with NET/GATE or equivalent national level exam and two years research experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years, with age relaxations applicable based on sponsor agency rules where permitted.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply for IIT Kharagpur SRF?
faq.answer: No application fee is required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, and ST categories as the fee is listed as Nil.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IIT Kharagpur SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises Document Verification followed by an Interview of shortlisted candidates based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official recruitment portal of IIT Kharagpur before the closing date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and direct apply link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for downloading the official notification PDF and accessing the online application portal in the Important Links section of this article.
